segments.sn35.165:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.165:1.3: “kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatī”ti?
segments.sn35.165:2.1: “Cakkhuṃ kho, bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
segments.sn35.165:2.2: Rūpe aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
segments.sn35.165:2.3: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
segments.sn35.165:2.4: Cakkhusamphassaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati … pe … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
segments.sn35.165:2.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatī”ti.
